originalFrozenTask.learnerTask: Distinguish a new-cell split from a new-donor or unseen-intervention test.
originalFrozenTask.gap: The training pipeline does not depict donor overlap across partitions.
originalFrozenTask.accuracyGuardrails: Track donor/intervention identities across partitions, not merely different cells or files. A held-out-cell split from a shared donor can leak context; it is not evidence for a new-donor or unseen-intervention claim.

generatorCustody: Privately retained original construction code, not publicly delivered. SVGs are editable; no executable reproduction package promised.
sourceDepth: Actual selected primary/official passages or primary abstracts; per-owner private lookup receipts identify exact reading depth, failures and custody. No whole-paper, clinical or current-platform validation implied.
sourceCustody: Source bodies and reading/execution/capture receipts retained privately.
